correctness.rationale: The recurrence at every starting position generates all dyadic boundary states, stabilizes at 24 by h=4, and an exact four-block/suffix formula recovers the complete 14-coordinate 3-Abelian signature. Enumeration of all 192 potential state-parity-offset images gives 32 classes at k=4 and 36 thereafter, with exactly twelve 2-Abelian fibers each of size three at k>=5. The standalone verifier recomputes all finite images and checks direct 1-/2-/3-gram counts for every direct factor of seven finite prefixes. Finite sampling is not asserted to prove the infinite theorem; stabilization and state coverage do.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Since 3-Abelian equivalence implies 2-Abelian equivalence, a known twelve-class 2-Abelian result only bounds the number of finer classes below by twelve; it cannot imply that each coarse fiber contains three finer classes. value.rationale: Exact all-depth stable three-letter grammatical spectra of a classical aperiodic automatic sequence are a natural higher-order complexity invariant; uniform three-way splitting of every dyadic 2-Abelian class and an exceptional k=4 transition explain the structural effect of refining equivalence. A 24-state identity proves an infinite class classification, beyond finite datasets or algebraic renamings.
